rule.name: IntegerDivision
rule.message: Integer division truncates the result; cast an operand to double/float or use BigDecimal instead.
rule.description: The / operator applied to two integral operands performs integer (truncating) division. This is rarely intentional and often indicates a precision bug. Cast at least one operand to a floating-point type, or store one operand in a double/float variable first.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //InfixExpression[@Operator = "/"] [*[1][ pmd-java:typeIs("int") or pmd-java:typeIs("long") or pmd-java:typeIs("short") or pmd-java:typeIs("byte") or pmd-java:typeIs("char") ]] [*[2][ pmd-java:typeIs("int") or pmd-java:typeIs("long") or pmd-java:typeIs("short") or pmd-java:typeIs("byte") or pmd-java:typeIs("char") ]]
